articles.summary: HILLSBORO, Ore. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026-- Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC), the low power programmable and platform firmware leader, today announced a collaboration with Arm to enable secure control, management, and platform adaptability for AI infrastructure.
articles.title: Lattice Collaborates with Arm to Advance Secure, Adaptable AI Data Center Infrastructure
